lines.en: : Hey, Molly. I just figured I’d come keep you company since you’re drunk and alone and no one seems to be paying any attention to you.
lines.zh: : 嗨，Molly。我就是想着，既然你又醉又一个人待着，而且看起来没人在意你，那我就过来陪陪你。

lines.en: : ‘Ell if I know. Probably...bein’ a cat?
lines.zh: : 我咋知道。大概……当猫去了？

lines.en: : I ever tell you how I feel about cats?
lines.zh: : 我跟你说过我对猫是啥看法吗？

lines.en: : I don’t think that topic has ever come up before, no.
lines.zh: : 我觉得这话题以前从没提起过，没有。

lines.en: : How much have you had to drink?
: Well, that more or less answers that.
: Ye want’some, Sensei? Can *hic* finish mine if ye pay me for it.
lines.zh: : 要不要来一口，Sensei？你付钱的话我可以*嗝*把这瓶喝完。

lines.en: : Why would I pay you for a half empty beer in a place where I can very likely get as many of them as I want for free?
lines.zh: : 我为什么要花钱买你半空的啤酒，况且在这个地方我很可能想拿多少就有多少，还免费？

lines.en: : Do I look like an optimist to you? Of course it’s half empty.
lines.zh: : 我看起来像乐观主义者吗？当然是半空。
: 哈！这你可就*嗝*错了！我刚……

lines.en: So, it appears that I may have shown up a bit too late to prevent Molly from slipping into an alcohol induced coma.
lines.zh: 看来，我出现得可能有点太晚了，没能阻止 Molly 滑进酒精性昏迷。

lines.en: Is she still standing right now? Sure. But...there’s no way that’s going to last much longer.
lines.zh: 她这会儿还站着吗？站着。但……这状态肯定撑不了多久了。

lines.en: I’m glad she at least decided to drink alone instead of taking Kirin up on her offer, though.
lines.zh: 不过至少她选择一个人喝，而不是接受 Kirin 的提议，这让我挺高兴的。

lines.en: It’s one thing to get blackout drunk, but a completely different thing to get blackout drunk around someone who would likely attempt to [molest] you.
lines.zh: 烂醉如泥是一回事，在一个很可能会试图 [molest] 你的人身边烂醉如泥，那完全是另一回事。

lines.en: : Where did you even get that? I thought everyone was actively trying to prevent a repeat of last year.
lines.zh: : 你到底从哪儿弄来的？我还以为所有人都在积极防止去年那事重演呢。
: 当然是*嗝*从酒水房里拿的啊。

lines.en: : Sensei. Nooooobody’s tryin’ to stop me from doin’ anything.
lines.zh: : Sensei。没、没、没人拦着我做任何事。

lines.en: : She here now? Or is she a...*hic* {i}traitor{/i} who left me all alone to go talk to my arch nemesis?
lines.zh: : 她现在人呢？还是说她是个*嗝*{i}叛徒{/i}，丢下我一个人跑去跟我的死对头说话了？
: Rin 现在成你死对头了？

lines.en: : Juss {i}look{/i} at her! Holdin’ hands with a {i}girl{/i}.
lines.zh: : 你{i}看看{/i}她！跟个{i}女生{/i}牵着手。

lines.en: Well, on the bright side, this time she’s yelling about lesbians and not her father.
lines.zh: 嗯，往好处想，这次她喊的是女同性恋，不是她爸。

lines.en: That is a step in the right direction.
lines.zh: 这算是朝正确的方向迈了一步。

lines.en: I don’t think either one of those things is a particularly {i}good{/i} thing to yell about while inebriated beyond belief in a room full of your peers.
lines.zh: 我觉得这两样，都不太{i}适合{/i}在满屋子同龄人面前、醉得不省人事的时候扯着嗓子喊。

lines.en: But, again, at least she’s standing.
lines.zh: 但再说一遍，至少她还站着。

lines.en: : Why ya just lookin’ at me with those...eyes?
lines.zh: : 你干嘛用那种……眼神看我？

lines.en: : {s}Can you hear me?{/s} I don’t really...know.
lines.zh: : {s}你能听见我说话吗{/s}？我真的……不知道。

lines.en: : Ay! If you’ve got sometin’ ta say, ye best say it before I start yellin’!
lines.zh: : 哎！你有啥话要说，趁我还没开始喊赶紧说！

lines.en: : {s}Everything is better where it’s dark.{/s} You’re already yelling, though.
lines.zh: : {s}在黑暗的地方，一切都会更好{/s}。不过你已经在喊了。

lines.en: : {s}GO! RUN!{/s} I just wanted to know what-
{b}/////////////////////////PLEASE TAKE YOUR TIME IN FAMILIARIZING YOURSELF WITH THIS INFORMATION{/b}
lines.zh: {b}/////////////////////////PLEASE TAKE YOUR TIME IN FAMILIARIZING YOURSELF WITH THIS INFORMATION{/b}

lines.en: {b}/////////////////////////PLEASE CONTINUE TO RAISE YOUR AFFECTION WITH MOLLY MACCORMACK{/b}
lines.zh: {b}/////////////////////////PLEASE CONTINUE TO RAISE YOUR AFFECTION WITH MOLLY MACCORMACK{/b}

lines.en: {b}/////////////////////////PLEASE CONTINUE TO SPEND TIME WITH MOLLY MACCORMACK{/b}
lines.zh: {b}/////////////////////////PLEASE CONTINUE TO SPEND TIME WITH MOLLY MACCORMACK{/b}

lines.en: : Really, though! Who the *hic* heck do they think they are?!
lines.zh: : 说真的！她们*嗝*到底以为自己是谁啊？！

lines.en: : What is this? A {i}love{/i} hotel? Have some tact!
lines.zh: : 这算什么？{i}情人{/i}旅馆吗？有点分寸行不行！

lines.en: : I know! Disgusting, right?! In a place like *hic* this. The nerve!
lines.zh: : 我知道！恶心吧？！在*嗝*这种地方。真是有脸！

lines.en: : To be fair, the two of them are dating now and, if they want to hold hands in public, it’s well within their right to do so.
lines.zh: : 说句公道话，她们俩现在在交往，如果她们想在公共场合牵手，那完全是她们的权利。

lines.en: : Sounds to me like we got...*hic*...an imposter in our midst.
lines.zh: : 我听着怎么像是我们中间出了个……*嗝*……冒充者。

lines.en: : You got ta nerve...ta come over ta me...and {i}not{/i} be on my side? Whaddya tink tis is? AMOGUS?!
lines.zh: : 你倒是有脸……过来找我……还{i}不{/i}站我这边？你以为这是啥？AMOGUS？！

lines.en: : I...have no idea what you’re talking about.
lines.zh: : 我……完全不知道你在说什么。

lines.en: : Cause ya never try ta learn! All ya do is sit in your fancy office chair, eat hot chip, and lie!
lines.zh: : 因为你从来不肯学着了解！你整天就坐在你那把高级办公椅上，吃着热薯片，撒谎！

lines.en: : How have you gotten drunker by just...standing there and not drinking?
lines.zh: : 你怎么就只是……站着不喝，还能越喝越醉的？

lines.en: : I had a whole other *hic* beer while you were starin’ off inta space!
lines.zh: : 你盯着空气发呆的时候我又*嗝*干了一整瓶！

lines.en: : Ya see anytin’ out there, Sensei?! ‘Dya find Haruka’s husband?!
lines.zh: : 你看见啥了没，Sensei？！找到 Haruka 的老公了吗？！

lines.en: : When was I staring off into space?
lines.zh: : 我什么时候盯着空气发呆了？

lines.en: : Unbelievable! Kids these days! Always on their phones and not even payin’ attention to ta world around ‘em.
lines.zh: : 真是不可理喻！现在的年轻人！成天抱着手机，连周围的世界都不看一眼。

lines.en: : And now yer takin’ me freedom of speech?!
lines.zh: : 现在你还要夺走我的言论自由？！
: 快来人 @ 一下管理员！

lines.en: : Okay, you know what? I’m going to be a responsible adult and confiscate that beer from-
lines.zh: : 行吧，你知道吗？我要做个负责任的成年人，把那瓶啤酒从你手里没收——

lines.en: : Okay, you know what? Let’s distract you from drinking anymore by talking more about Rin and Otoha.
lines.zh: : 行吧，你知道吗？我们换个法子，多聊聊 Rin 和 Otoha，好让你别再喝了。

lines.en: : I shoulda never came to this party.
: Nobody wants ta talk to me when they’ve gotta burn their feet on coals ta do it.
lines.zh: : 没人愿意跟我说话，除非他们得踩着烧红的炭才能过来。

lines.en: : S’one ting ta have Futaba ditch me for ‘er best friend, but th’rest o’ta manga club’s too’fraid ta’proach me while we’ve got Little Miss PDA and her super hot girlfriend makin’ hand sex at the table.
lines.zh: : Futaba 为了她最好的朋友把我丢下一回事，可漫画社其他那帮人也不敢靠近我，就因为桌上坐着「秀恩爱小姐」和她那个超辣的女朋友在那儿搞手部性行为。

lines.en: : Please don’t call holding hands “hand sex.” It makes me feel strange.
lines.zh: : 拜托别把牵手叫「手部性行为」。这让我感觉怪怪的。

lines.en: : If it makes {i}you{/i} feel strange, imagine how I feel!
lines.zh: : 你觉得怪，那{i}你{/i}想想我什么感觉！

lines.en: : S’like when ya die to th’frickin’ dance on Council of Blood and have to sit there watchin’ everyone else boogie down while ya ask yer death knight for a b-res!
lines.zh: : 就像在 Council of Blood 里被那个该死的舞步搞死，然后只能干坐着看其他人跳舞，还得求你的死亡骑士给个战复！

lines.en: : S’like pingin’ for your jungler to gank mid because ‘yer getting ‘yer arse handed to ya, but he’s too busy campin’ top because that’s where ‘is friend is laning!
lines.zh: : 就像你打信号叫打野来中路gank，因为你被打爆了，结果他忙着蹲上路，因为他朋友在那路！

lines.en: : S’like when Genji asks you to nano boost ‘im but then dives in and get’s ‘is arse flash-fanned by McCree!
lines.zh: : 就像 Genji 叫你给他纳米激素，结果他一头扎进去，被 McCree 一个闪光弹扇了屁股！

lines.en: : Oh, sorry- Cole frickin’ Cassidy’s ‘is name now because Blizzard’s conflict resolution team’s run by a’bunch’a monkeys.
lines.zh: : 哦，抱歉——现在人家叫 Cole frickin’ Cassidy 了，因为 Blizzard 的冲突处理团队是一群猴子在管。

lines.en: Molly is so drunk at this point that she has begun making up words and people and...I really have no idea how to handle it.
lines.zh: Molly 已经醉到开始编造词语和人物了，而我……真的完全不知道该怎么处理。

lines.en: : I’m sure it doesn’t feel great being you right now, but...
lines.zh: : 我相信你现在的感觉肯定很不好受，不过……

lines.en: : But what, Sir? What can ya possibly say right now tat’ll make me feel any better?
lines.zh: : 不过什么，先生？你现在到底能说出什么让我好受一点的话？

lines.en: : You know, I probably should have thought of that before speaking because I’ve honestly got nothing.
lines.zh: : 你知道吗，我开口之前大概该先想好的，因为我真的什么都没有。

lines.en: : But hey. {i}I’m{/i} here. And I’ve been diffusing problems left and right since I showed up.
lines.zh: : 但是嘿。{i}我{/i}在这儿啊。而且从我出现到现在，我一直在左一个右一个地化解问题。

lines.en: This obviously isn’t true since I’ve been tossed into four or five of them at this point and really haven’t resolved any.
lines.zh: 这显然不是真的，因为这会儿我已经被扔进四五个问题里了，而且一个都没解决。

lines.en: But Molly doesn’t need to know that.
lines.zh: 但 Molly 不需要知道这一点。

lines.en: She just needs someone to lean on.
lines.zh: 她只是需要一个可以靠着的人。

lines.en: Literally, because she is going to fall over any minute now.
lines.zh: 字面意义上的，因为她随时都会倒下去。

lines.en: : But so am I. And that’s exactly the problem, Sensei.
lines.zh: : 可我也在啊。而问题恰恰就在这儿，Sensei。

lines.en: : Go back to calling me Sir, please. Hearing you say “Sensei” repeatedly is somehow the weirdest part of all of this to me.
lines.zh: : 别叫我 Sensei 了，改回「先生」吧。听你一遍遍喊「Sensei」，不知怎么成了这整件事里最让我别扭的部分。

lines.en: : I’ll try, Sir. But I can barely feel me face right now.
lines.zh: : 我尽量，先生。可我现在连自己的脸都快没知觉了。

lines.en: : Is she {i}tryin’{/i} to make me jealous or d’she literally forget I exist? Which one is it, Sir?!
lines.zh: : 她{i}是想{/i}让我吃醋，还是压根就忘了我这号人？到底是哪一种，先生？！

lines.en: : She’s just enjoying herself with her new girlfriend.
lines.zh: : 她只是跟她的新女朋友玩得开心而已。

lines.en: : You’re not even succeeding at being Molly right now.
lines.zh: : 你现在连当好 Molly 都做不到。

lines.en: : You drank yourself into a stupor to avoid having to deal with your problems because you can’t play video games right now and are handling the consequences of that decision by just...complaining.
lines.zh: : 你把自己喝到神志不清，就为了不用去面对自己的问题，因为你现在没法打游戏，然后你处理这个决定的后果的方式就是……抱怨。

lines.en: : Sounds pretty familiar to me, Sir.
: Nothin’ says the Emerald Guardian like hidin’ your problems behind other stuff while *hic* shummle...taneously complainin’ about ‘em.
lines.zh: : 把问题藏在别的东西后面，还*嗝*同时……同时抱怨它们，这才叫翡翠守护者嘛。

lines.en: : Maybe not, but I {i}am{/i} sober- which allows me to do this thing where I say words correctly.
lines.zh: : 也许没有，但我很{i}清醒{/i}——这让我能做到一件事：把话说对。

lines.en: : You’ve been on my case ta whole night! Why aren’t ya makin’ me feel better?!
lines.zh: : 你一整晚都在挑我毛病！你为什么就不能让我好受点？！

lines.en: : What do you want me to do? Go force Rin to talk to you?
lines.zh: : 你想让我怎么做？去硬逼 Rin 跟你说话？

lines.en: : The last time we tried that, she not only made you cry, but made {i}me{/i} sit there holding her arm closed so she didn’t bleed out.
lines.zh: : 上次{i}我{/i}们试过，结果她不光把你弄哭了，还让我坐在那儿按住她的胳膊不让她失血过多。

lines.en: : Bet her new {i}girlfriend{/i} doesn’t even know about that yet.
lines.zh: : 我打赌她那个新{i}女朋友{/i}还不知道这事呢。

lines.en: : F’I know Rin, she’s just gonna hide it and hide it and hide it and pretend everyting’s okay ‘til she gets caught.
lines.zh: : 我了解 Rin，她会一直瞒、一直瞒、一直瞒，假装一切都好，直到被拆穿。

lines.en: : S’what she always does. I know ‘er better t’en I know meself.
lines.zh: : 她一贯如此。我了解她比了解我自己还深。

lines.en: : That checks out. Because pretending everything is okay until you get caught is exactly what you did concerning your feelings for her, isn’t it?
lines.zh: : 这话说得通。因为「假装一切都好直到被拆穿」正是你面对自己对她的感情时做过的事，不是吗？

lines.en: : It wasn’t meant to be mean. I’m just pointing out how you and Rin aren’t that different-
lines.zh: : 我不是故意要刻薄。我只是在指出你和 Rin 没那么不一样——

lines.en: : I know that, Sir! Why do you think I like her so much?!
lines.zh: : 我知道啊，先生！不然你以为我为什么那么喜欢她？！

lines.en: : Molly, I know you’re drunk, but someone is going to hear you if you keep yelling like that.
lines.zh: : Molly，我知道你醉了，但你要是继续这么喊，会有人听见的。

lines.en: : Let ‘em! S’not like t’ey care anyway!
lines.zh: : 让他们听见！反正他们也不在乎！

lines.en: : Of course they do. They...probably just don’t want to spend a night that is supposed to be fun consoling a drunken girl who’s still pining after a friend in a relationship.
lines.zh: : 他们当然在乎。他们……大概只是不想把一个本该开心的夜晚，花在安慰一个还在对一个已经有对象了的朋友念念不忘的醉酒女孩身上。

lines.en: : Molly, there are no sides. You’re both [teenager]s with little to no impulse control who are going to get hurt and make stupid decisions because that is the part of life you’re in right now.
lines.zh: : Molly，没有什么这边那边。你们俩都是 [teenager]，几乎没什么自制力，会受伤、会做蠢决定，因为这就是你们当下所处的人生阶段。

lines.en: : I’m just trying to avoid you making things worse than they already are, which, judging by the condition you’re in and the literal tears in your eyes, is pretty bad.
lines.zh: : 我只是想避免你把事情弄得比现在更糟，而从你的状态和你眼里货真价实的泪水来看，已经够糟了。

lines.en: : Do you have any idea how many hallways this place has? No one will ever see you again.
lines.zh: : 你知道这地方有多少条走廊吗？以后没人会再见到你了。

lines.en: : Well maybe things are *hic* better that way!
Molly opens up some door near the back of the room and disappears inside.
lines.zh: Molly 推开房间后面某扇门，消失在里面。

lines.en: Not only am I thankful that she didn’t elect to turn into the hall of many halls (The cool name I’ve decided to give to Ayane’s maze thing), but I’m glad she’s going to be alone for a while.
lines.zh: 我不仅庆幸她没选择拐进那个「万厅之厅」（我给 Ayane 那个迷宫玩意儿起的酷名字），也很高兴她能一个人待一会儿。

lines.en: Granted, she’s been alone ever since Futaba left her side- but still.
lines.zh: 虽说从 Futaba 离开她身边开始，她就一直是一个人——但还是。

lines.en: She’s safer locked away in some room than out in the open, screaming about how mean I am and how her friend should be dating her instead.
lines.zh: 她锁在某间屋子里，总比在外面大喊大叫、说我多刻薄、说她的朋友该跟她而不是别人交往要安全。

lines.en: But, at the same time, thousands of people die every year by choking on their vomit after passing out drunk.
lines.zh: 但与此同时，每年有成千上万的人因为醉倒后被自己的呕吐物呛死。

lines.en: That’s not a real statistic, but it sounds believable enough and I know for a fact that it does happen {i}sometimes{/i}.
lines.zh: 这不是什么真实统计数据，但听起来足够可信，而且我确实知道这种事{i}有时候{/i}会发生。

lines.en: : How much of that did you hear?
: Enough to know that you hurt Molly’s feelings.
lines.zh: : 够我知道你伤了 Molly 的心。

lines.en: : Thankfully, she won’t remember that I hurt her feelings because of how drunk she is.
lines.zh: : 谢天谢地，她醉成那样，不会记得我伤了她的心。

lines.en: : You should still go to her, Sensei.
: Even if it wasn’t on purpose, you made her cry. So now it’s your job to make her feel better.
lines.zh: : 就算不是故意的，你也把她弄哭了。所以现在让她好起来是你的责任。

lines.en: : What are you even doing over here? I thought you were playing a game with Nodoka and company.
lines.zh: : 你在这儿干什么？我还以为你在跟 Nodoka 她们玩游戏呢。

lines.en: : I’ll make sure no one gets in the way.
: You...definitely attracted some attention with Molly’s yelling...and...my group was kind of already looking over here, so...
lines.zh: : 你……刚才 Molly 那一喊肯定招来不少目光……而且……我那组人本来就已经往这边看了，所以……

lines.en: : Do you want to come with me?
: Just had a feeling you might want to.
lines.zh: : 只是有种感觉，觉得你可能会想。

lines.en: : Wipe that frown off of Molly’s face! And make sure she drinks some water while you’re at it!
lines.zh: : 把 Molly 脸上那道愁容擦掉！顺便让她喝点水！

lines.en: : But the second she starts accusing me of taking sides again, I’m coming back out here and hanging out with you instead.
lines.zh: : 但她一旦又开始指责我选边站，我就立刻回这儿来，改跟你混。

lines.en: : Nyahaha! You may think that, but the truth is that I’m far too cool for you, Sensei!
lines.zh: : 喵哈哈！你尽管这么想，但事实是，我对你来说太酷了，Sensei！

lines.en: : You’ll be forced to sit with your [niece] and her friends instead!
lines.zh: : 你只能被迫去跟你的 [niece] 和她的朋友们坐一块儿！

lines.en: : But things got weird there last time...
lines.zh: : 可上次在那儿气氛变得很怪……

lines.en: : Don’t wanna hear it, mister! Your time with Uta-nyan has expired!
lines.zh: : 不听不听，先生！你和 Uta-nyan 的时间已经用完了！

lines.en: : If you’d like to proceed with the conversation, please give her six billion yen.
lines.zh: : 如果你想继续对话，请付给她六十亿日元。

lines.en: : Why the hell have your rates gone up so much?
lines.zh: : 你的报价到底为什么涨这么多啊？

lines.en: : Now go! Go go go go go! Make the Irish girl smile and you'll get free flavor beams for the next month!
lines.zh: : 快去！去去去去去！让那个爱尔兰女孩笑起来，接下来一个月你就能免费获得风味光线！

lines.en: I make my way across the hall and look back to find Uta explaining to a few of the other girls what’s going on.
lines.zh: 我穿过厅堂走过去，回头看见 Uta 正在跟几个女生解释发生了什么。

lines.en: Well, it’s probably something closer to {i}attempting{/i} to explain what is going on since I, a person who was there for the entire exchange, do not fully understand.
lines.zh: 嗯，与其说是「解释」，不如说是在「{i}试图{/i}解释」，因为连我这个全程在场的人都没完全搞明白。

lines.en: So, let’s recap what I {i}do{/i} know.
lines.zh: 那么，来复盘一下我{i}确实{/i}知道的事。

lines.en: Molly is mad at virtually everything.
lines.zh: Molly 几乎在生所有东西的气。

lines.en: I want to take her costume off.
I want to take her costume off.
No one is coming to the room.
I want to take her costume off.
I am using my feet to walk toward Molly.
lines.zh: 我在用我的脚朝 Molly 走过去。

lines.en: I want to take her costume off.
I want to take her costume off.
I want to take her costume off.
I want to take her costume off.
No one is coming to the room.
I want to make her feel better.
I came here to make Molly feel better.
lines.zh: 我来这儿是为了让 Molly 好受一点。

lines.en: {s}{i}Molly’s affection has increased to [molly_love]!{/s} I want to take her costume off.{/i}
lines.zh: {s}Molly 的好感度提升到了 [molly_love]！{/s}{i}我想把她的装扮脱掉{/i}。
